title: I Build a Gaming site, where you can ask ai to create any game you can imagine, publish it, and other users can play them.
author: Ok_Award_3049
selftext:
I hope you guys are OK with me posting here, i really just want some general feedback on my platform.   
Been working on this for a long time, and its finally at a place, where i can go public with it. 

Essentially, its a 2d gaming site, like the good old days. The difference is, if there is a game you want to play, thats not on the site, you can easily create your own (and maybe with your own twist), publish it, and play it. 

Its free to play all games on the site, at all time, and there is a free tier for game development. But after this, its a monthly sub to keep creating games. 

I wont give you the full sales speech, but hope you will check it out. I really just want some honest, direct feedback. 

NOTE!! Its meant for desktop, so mobile version is locked in most places. It can create mobile friendly games though (search these if needed). 

Site is: [www.playable.gg](http://www.playable.gg)

comments.author: W0RKABLE
comments.body:
Many of these sites are showing up here recently and all of them make the same type of games.  
I guess we will see more and more, since it's a very simple concept. Today, any LLM can generate a game for you in the browser.

I see you created your account today, and you came here for the first time just to promote this. So I'm just letting you know. This is not an original concept and we've seen it many many times.

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body: Update: I just saw another post in this sub, 3 hours ago, promoting exactly the same type of website. Different, but same.

replies.author: darknessinducedlove
replies.body: Dont sleep on how deep browser games can go

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body: Oh don't get me wrong, I love browser games, and I've released many myself. But browser games have very small barrier to entry, that's why we see so many low-effort ones, coming from these tools.

replies.author: darknessinducedlove
replies.body: Would you mind giving mine a try? Been at it for awhile and could use feedback

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body:
https://preview.redd.it/wehd5xqhzzqg1.png?width=3831&format=png&auto=webp&s=e2cf7172840c5f9864fea7db1f3189895cb76f8a

The style and vibe looks very cool!  
But can't do much unfortunately because the UI doesn't fit my screen.  
I have a 27inch 4K screen.

Some of the text is also hard to read when it's on top of the characters (but maybe that's the same responsivness issue). I also didn't understand what to do in the first keyboard screen, I tried writing something, and clicking letters but nothing happened. Only clicking submit worked.

replies.author: darknessinducedlove
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback. I'll address this

replies.author: darknessinducedlove
replies.body: Also want to add that im developing it for mobile. Id try it on your phone

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body:
That's a valid choice, in that case you can also just show a popup when people visit on desktop.

Are you planning to release on app stores and package with Capacitor?

replies.author: darknessinducedlove
replies.body:
I am. The server infastructure is already built. This is an open world survival with gps integration. The entire world is the playground. Every building an enterable scene.

Gameplay is raycaster with a tick-based formula (action turn based).

replies.author: Ok_Award_3049
replies.body:
I have been following this sub for a long time, but created the account to post this on here, correct. My other acoount is personal :)
